description: Thin orange, yellow, and red lines move from the top left to the bottom center of the composition. The lines ripple and curl in on each other like wisps of smoke. Framing these lines are softly shaded hints of blue, green, and purple.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
